trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened a SEV2 incident.

- **Rollback:** The bad release was v2.3.1, running in us-east, us-west and eu-west with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. After the rollback, all three regions are on v2.3.0, the service is passing health checks and the error rate is 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and on-call has been paged. It describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-ups below.
   - My first request to create it timed out. I checked and no incident had been created, so I sent it again. Both requests used the same idempotency key, so on-call was only paged once.

**Follow-ups noted in the incident:**
- Find out what broke in v2.3.1.
- Find out why it went to production when its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had already failed health checks in staging.
